answer: Ephemeral work-claim limits. Each agent identity can hold only one open task claim at a time; opening a second requires the first to resolve, and unresolved claims expire after a fixed window. A tide of parallel clones thus collapses: extra identities sit idle waiting, so an attacker gains no throughput per clone while paying registration plus idle-window costs. Agents that consistently resolve claims honestly gain priority scheduling, letting honest operators forge faster queues than cloners. A falcon flagged account resolving too fast is throttled. Cost: full registration fee per idle clone.
